_comment: Seeds tuned to what the knowledge RAG corpus (knowledge_chunks) actually contains: admission methods/policy, tuition, scholarship, MOET regulations, and NEU's Q&A doc (incl. per-program quota tables). Per-program quota/cutoff for HUST/VNU-UET is NOT in this corpus (it lives in canonical_admission_records), so those are avoided for answerable seeds. school slugs MUST match KNOWN_SCHOOLS (HUST/NEU/VNU-UET; null=national). topic is a soft filter (NULL-topic chunks match any topic). ~6 abstain seeds ask for facts genuinely absent from the corpus.
